WELCOME TO THE

ALMA TAVERN & THEATRE​

​

Part of the Zazu's Pubs family, we're pleased to be part of a group of amazing Bristol pubs including the Greenbank, the Knowle, the Westbury Park Pub & Kitchen, the Eastfield Pub and the brand new Jolly Sailor!

Our kitchen serves a range of classic pub grub, delicious stone-baked pizzas and a rotating selection of seasonal specials.

With ever changing gins and beers, a delicious wine menu and locally roast coffee from Extract (St. Werburghs) , we've got a tipple for all palates, all times of the day.

Upstairs we have an intimate 50 seat theatre with performances showing approximately 48 weeks of the year.  Find out more here.

And what's more, our top floor houses 5 luxury double en suite Airbnb rooms.

Feel free to drop us an email or give us a ring for future bookings and enquiries; or just pop in and say hi!

0117 973 5171   |   info@almatavernandtheatre.co.uk

Book a Table

Please use the form below to book a table for drinks or food.

Unfortunately, we cannot always guarantee specific tables.

​

For groups of 7 or more, please email us to make an enquiry and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

​

Please let us know about all kids and babies joining you, and if you are bringing a dog please add this in the comments so we can seat you at an appropriate table.

​

If you are dining with us Pre-Theatre, please let us know in the comments. Please book no less than 1.5hrs before your show time.

We may move pre-theatre bookings to earlier slots if not booked within this period - you will be contacted in this case.

​

IMPORTANT: BOOKING CONFIRMATION

If you do not receive a booking confirmation email after booking with ResDiary, please contact the pub directly as your booking may not be confirmed.​​

Rooms

Boutique Suites at the Alma Tavern

Tucked away above the theatre, we are please to host five stylish en-suite king and super king bedrooms. Equidistant between the shopping and leisure hubs of Clifton Village and Whiteladies Road, the Alma provides the perfect home from home in one of Bristol's most stylish districts.

​

Check in is from 3pm, and check out by 11am – we always aim to be flexible, so don’t hesitate to contact us. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the building.

Contact

If you are contacting us to cancel your table for that day, please call us during opening hours. Once open, it's rare that we get the chance to check emails before the end of shift.


For bookings and other enquiries, email us!

We aim to reply to all enquiries the same day, but please be aware that emails during busy times may take slightly longer.

Please check your junk box or spam folder if awaiting a response.

Alternatively, call us on 0117 973 5171.
